sentences.text:
Gunduboyana Venkatarattnam, vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh,
on 1 September, 2020
Author: D.Ramesh

Bench: D.Ramesh
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice D.Ramesh
 Criminal Petition No.3511 of 2020
Order:

This petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 by the petitioner,
who is accused No.1 in Crime No.528 of 2020 on the file of Renigunta Urban Police Station, Tirupati Urban District.

entities.text: Renigunta Urban Police Station, Tirupati Urban District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
The offences alleged are under sections 188, 270, 273, 328 and 420 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, Section 24(1) read with 27 of the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production,
Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003, Section 3 of Epidemic Diseases Act, 1897, Section 59(1) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and Section 4 of Gutka and Pan Masala (Prohibition) Act,
2015.

entities.text:
Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production,
Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent.
3.
Both the counsel submit that the issue involved in this petition is squarely covered by the order dated 27.08.2018, passed by this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731of 2018 and batch.

4. In view of the above and in terms of the afore said order, this Criminal petition is partly allowed and the proceedings against the petitioner in Crime No.528 of 2020 on the file of Renigunta Urban Police Station are hereby quashed, except the offence under Section 3 of the Epidemic Diseases Act,
for which offence the investigation may go on.
As a sequel thereto, the miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this criminal petition shall stand closed.
5. The Registry is directed to attach a copy of the order in Criminal Petition No.3731of 2018, dated 27.08.2018 to this order.

JUSTICE D.RAMESH Date: 01.9.2020 Note:
Dispatch order copy tomorrow.
